notes: A cohort is a named set of securities defined by some membership rule. A screen is the language for membership rules. So a cohort *is* a screen — and the two capabilities should be one. This is the first step of collapsing them: proving the screen language can define every cohort we have. It nearly could already. A sector is sector in [...]. A size band is a marketCap bound. A factor cohort is a fundamentals predicate. And a hand list is symbol in [...] — which is exactly why a watchlist was only ever a screen wearing a different name. The one membership rule that is *not* a predicate over fun
